nomi.name: nomi
nomi.tagline: Keep your memories safe and relive them anytime.
nomi.description: nomi is your private home for memories – photos, moments and stories in one safe place. Keep what really matters most, beautifully stored and ready to relive.

features.title: Preserve memories
features.text: Store photos and moments as private memories – safe and forever.

features.title: Relive anytime
features.text: Browse your past and let your favorite moments come back to life.

features.title: Private & secure
features.text: Your data belongs to you. Encrypted, private and ad-free.

privacy.title: Your memories stay yours
privacy.subtitle: nomi is built so the moments you keep belong only to you.

sections.heading: Private by design
sections.text: Your memories live in a private space made just for you. Nothing is shared, profiled or sold.

sections.heading: Encrypted
sections.text: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, so only you can reach your memories.

sections.heading: No tracking, no ads
sections.text: nomi has no trackers and no advertising. We never profile you or sell your data.

sections.heading: Your data, your control
sections.text: Export or delete your memories at any time. Your data stays under your control.

privacy.ctaSub: Our team is happy to help with anything related to your data.

support.title: We're here to help with nomi
support.subtitle: Find answers, report issues and reach our team directly.

sections.heading: Getting started
sections.text: Set up your account and add your first memories in just a few steps.

sections.heading: Accounts & data
sections.text: Manage your account, or export and delete your memories whenever you like.

sections.heading: Reporting issues
sections.text: Something not working as expected? Tell us and we'll fix it quickly.

support.ctaSub: Write to us and we'll get back to you shortly.

items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: Open nomi and follow the on-screen steps. You'll need just an email and a secure password.

items.question: Are my memories private?
items.answer: Yes. Your memories are encrypted and never shared, profiled or sold. They belong to you.

items.question: Can I export or delete my memories?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can export or delete your memories at any time from your account settings.
